plugins.description: A spellbook of agent skills for AI. Cast wisely. incantation lets you talk with your session by voice, head-chef leads a brigade of sessions from one Claude Desktop chat, contract turns agreed terms into a skill or agent, eagle-eye lays out coupled decisions, and groundtrack draws a plan as a call graph.
